main_question_display: shared first sentence only; full prompts are in caption_v1.md
design_audit: Anthropic research-blog inspired: direct labels, hairline dividers, restrained tint, minimal visible metadata, no decorative chrome

layout_audit.text_alignment: all single-line labels use verticalAlign=middle and spacing=0; boxed trace items use centered text before the colored end marker

nonthinking.head_readout_marker: thin Sunset Pink rule at the exact end of the forced answer prefix, immediately before the generated integer
nonthinking.prompt_demo_display: raw per-token attention clipped at positive q99.7; every token uses one span-independent nonlinear transform, followed by a uniform 0.62 display-lightness multiplier: 0.62*[0.004+0.946*(log(1+1000*v)/log(1001))^0.62]

native_thinking.trace_display: verbatim primary item spans from the stored numbered-list trace; ellipses mark omitted surrounding reasoning and later items
native_thinking.prompt_demo_resolution: exact key-wise token attention captured at output endpoints 236/244/252; one shared q98 clip and the documented span-independent monotone token transform are applied to all three shown windows; colored rules mark item-end queries

pca_shared_view.camera_source: shared adjusted manifold view: yaw=-0.72 rad, pitch=-0.45 rad

pca_display_cohort: confirmation only: 10 seeds × 10 count states per mode

pca_display_scales.note: uniform screen-space footprint balancing only; axes retain identical fixed lengths and are orientation cues, not scale bars

pca_layer_selection.rule: each mode independently maximizes discovery-set grouped-OOF nearest-centroid balanced accuracy; ties are resolved by higher discovery logistic balanced accuracy and then the earlier layer

pca_ncc.definition: held-out confirmation nearest-centroid balanced accuracy; computed independently of the display camera

pca_axis_embedding: pure dark-gray PC1/PC2/PC3 axes originate at each subplot's screen centre, extend behind each manifold, and share one camera; three sparse background line families remain exactly parallel to the projected PC axes and use three matched, equally spaced positive/negative offset pairs around the visible origin; their central lines align with the labeled axes; PC1 and PC3 use the equivalent negative display sign so their positive rays point down and away from PC2; the non-thinking cloud uses a uniform 0.75x screen-space footprint scale while native-thinking uses 1.00x; the axis lengths remain identical and non-quantitative; ordinary state opacity is fixed at 58% with a fixed 5.6-unit diameter across both modes; centroid nodes use a fixed 15.5-unit diameter; path weight, foreshortening, and far-to-near painter ordering provide the depth cues
